note: rachat par la société de 152 870 520 actions A et 135 129 480 actions B détenues par SoftBank Group Capital Limited (désignée « SoftBank »), pour 7 132 milliers de dollars (montants de la note en milliers), le 23 mai 2023
quote: On May 23, 2023, the Company entered into a share repurchase agreement with SoftBank Group Capital Limited ("SoftBank"), pursuant to which the Company repurchased Class A and Class B ordinary shares of 152,870,520, and 135,129,480, respectively, from SoftBank.

note: second rachat, le 29 décembre 2023 : 117 388 451 actions A pour 2 459 milliers de dollars ; SoftBank n'est plus actionnaire ensuite
quote: On December 29, 2023, the Company entered into a share repurchase agreement with SoftBank, pursuant to which the Company repurchased from SoftBank 117,388,451 Class A ordinary shares, par value US$0.001 per share, of the Company, for a total purchase price of US$2,459.
